rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the grammatical class.

example.english: In English, a preposition usually comes before a noun.
example.traditional: 英文入面，介詞通常擺喺名詞前面。
example.jyutping: jing1 man4 jap6 min6 gaai3 ci4 tung1 soeng4 baai2 hai2 ming4 ci4 cin4 min6

rows.note: Use this more formal term when discussing a word positioned before its complement.

example.english: The teacher asked us to use the correct preposition in the report.
example.traditional: 老師要求我哋喺報告入面用返正確嘅前置詞。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 dei6 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 jung6 faan1 zing3 kok3 ge3 cin4 zi3 ci4
